Topics · The prophets

Were Noah, Moses and Jesus given one command?

One verse names all five and says the charge is one. What that means, and how it is tested outside the Quran.

Part 1 of 3

﴿شَرَعَ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلدِّينِ مَا وَصَّىٰ بِهِۦ نُوحًا وَٱلَّذِىٓ أَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَيْكَ وَمَا وَصَّيْنَا بِهِۦٓ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَمُوسَىٰ وَعِيسَىٰٓ ۖ أَنْ أَقِيمُوا۟ ٱلدِّينَ وَلَا تَتَفَرَّقُوا۟ فِيهِ ۚ كَبُرَ عَلَى ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ مَا تَدْعُوهُمْ إِلَيْهِ ۚ ٱللَّهُ يَجْتَبِىٓ إِلَيْهِ مَن يَشَآءُ وَيَهْدِىٓ إِلَيْهِ مَن يُنِيبُ﴾

Translation of the meaning

He has ordained for you of religion what He enjoined upon Noah and that which We have revealed to you, [O Muḥammad], and what We enjoined upon Abraham and Moses and Jesus - to establish the religion and not be divided therein. Difficult for those who associate others with Allāh is that to which you invite them. Allāh chooses for Himself whom He wills and guides to Himself whoever turns back [to Him].

Quran · Ash-Shura 42:13

The verse counts the names as if counting bearers of one letter: Noah. You. Abraham. Moses. Jesus. Long centuries in a single sentence. What the first carried, the last carried: establish the religion, and do not divide.

A question for you

What would one command need in order to cross a distance like this?

If you sayOne sender.
ThenThat is what the Quran says. The next part shows what it says was sent.
If you sayA shared human conscience.
ThenThat explains much of morality. Then ask whether it explains the worship of one God in particular.
If you sayA writer giving them one voice.
ThenThat is the strongest objection, and the third part takes it seriously.

Part 2 of 3

﴿مَّا يُقَالُ لَكَ إِلَّا مَا قَدْ قِيلَ لِلرُّسُلِ مِن قَبْلِكَ ۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَذُو مَغْفِرَةٍ وَذُو عِقَابٍ أَلِيمٍ﴾

Translation of the meaning

Nothing is said to you, [O Muḥammad], except what was already said to the messengers before you. Indeed, your Lord is a possessor of forgiveness and a possessor of painful penalty.

Quran · Fussilat 41:43

﴿وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ مِن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا نُوحِىٓ إِلَيْهِ أَنَّهُۥ لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّآ أَنَا۠ فَٱعْبُدُونِ﴾

Translation of the meaning

And We sent not before you any messenger except We revealed to him that, "There is no deity except Me, so worship Me."

Quran · Al-Anbiya 21:25

Translation

I am Yahweh, and there is no one else. Besides me, there is no God. I will strengthen you, though you have not known me,

Original · Hebrew

אֲנִ֤י יְהוָה֙ וְאֵ֣ין ע֔וֹד זוּלָתִ֖י אֵ֣ין אֱלֹהִ֑ים אֲאַזֶּרְךָ֖ וְלֹ֥א יְדַעְתָּֽנִי׃

Isaiah · 45:5

World English Bible

A man stands before his people and says: nothing I have is my own. This is what was said to those before me. He names them one by one. Some tell him: we came to hear something new. He reads them the same old sentence. The verse places the Prophet in that very stance.

A question for you

What does it show that he says he is nothing new among the messengers?

If you sayTrue humility.
ThenThat is close to what the verses describe, and a Step asks whether he brought a new religion.
If you sayA bid for legitimacy.
ThenA reasonable reply: joining the prophets lends weight. Set it beside the other strands.
If you sayThat he is part of one line.
ThenThen the line has to be tested from outside the Quran, and the next part shows how.

Part 3 of 3

﴿أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ هَدَى ٱللَّهُ ۖ فَبِهُدَىٰهُمُ ٱقْتَدِهْ ۗ قُل لَّآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ أَجْرًا ۖ إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرَىٰ لِلْعَـٰلَمِينَ﴾

Translation of the meaning

Those are the ones whom Allāh has guided, so from their guidance take an example. Say, "I ask of you for it [i.e., this message] no payment. It is not but a reminder for the worlds."

Quran · Al-An'am 6:90

Three brothers disagree over their father's will, and each opens his own chest. In the first is an old sheet, in the second an older one, in the third a new one. They read them together. The first line of each is the same line. They look at one another, and no one says a word.

A question for you

What would you like to do with this now?

If you sayCompare the texts myself.
ThenThe texts stand at the end of this Step, and another Step gathers them.
If you sayKnow exactly what they said.
ThenThat has its own Step.
If you sayKnow what this means for me.
ThenThat is the question left after all of this.

The same in the other books

Translation

Now therefore, Yahweh our God, save us, I beg you, out of his hand, that all the kingdoms of the earth may know that you, Yahweh, are God alone.”

Original · Hebrew

וְעַתָּה֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֔ינוּ הוֹשִׁיעֵ֥נוּ נָ֖א מִיָּד֑וֹ וְיֵֽדְעוּ֙ כָּל־מַמְלְכ֣וֹת הָאָ֔רֶץ כִּ֥י אַתָּ֛ה יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהִ֖ים לְבַדֶּֽךָ׃

2 Kings · 19:19

World English Bible

Translation

“Yet I am Yahweh your God from the land of Egypt; and you shall acknowledge no god but me, and besides me there is no savior.

Original · Hebrew

וְאָנֹכִ֛י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם וֵאלֹהִ֤ים זֽוּלָתִי֙ לֹ֣א תֵדָ֔ע וּמוֹשִׁ֥יעַ אַ֖יִן בִּלְתִּֽי׃

Hosea · 13:4

World English Bible

Translation

that they may know from the rising of the sun, and from the west, that there is no one besides me. I am Yahweh, and there is no one else.

Original · Hebrew

לְמַ֣עַן יֵדְע֗וּ מִמִּזְרַח־שֶׁ֨מֶשׁ֙ וּמִמַּ֣עֲרָבָ֔הּ כִּי־אֶ֖פֶס בִּלְעָדָ֑י אֲנִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה וְאֵ֥ין עֽוֹד׃

Isaiah · 45:6

World English Bible
